name: takeoff-studio
description: TakeOff Studio – quantity surveying take-off, BOQ and rates (MERN)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n engine,api,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run build:watch -w @takeoff/engine" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @takeoff/engine && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
